rules.name: missing-tables-legacy-schema
rules.sql: SELECT table_name, table_type, table_rows AS est_rows, create_time, table_comment FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (table_name REGEXP '^(accounting_actual_report_store_table|accounting_tr_drawdown_table|accounting_traders_report_data_table|actual_previous_settle_vol_accounting_tr_summary_table|asia_working_day_map_table|bbg_productcode_table|bbg_ticker_mapping_table|bi_counterparty_mapping_table|broker_bbg_mapping_table|broker_column_name_mapping_table|broker_deal_mapping_table|broker_trade_deal_master_table|brokerage_rate_type_table|client_cash_balance_contractwise_table|cost_master_table|dripping_counter_party_report_store_table|frequency_type_table|grasa_client_master_data|helper_screen_netting_table|input_security_settlement_value_cache_table|subportfolio_fy_monthwise_opening_balance_table|subportfolio_portfolio_table|helper_dbtodw_otctrade_dump_table|helper_dbtodw_exchtrade_dump_table|activity_log)(_[a-z0-9][a-z0-9][a-z0-9])?$') ORDER BY table_name

SELECT table_name, ordinal_position, column_name, column_type, data_type, character_maximum_length AS char_len, numeric_precision AS num_precision, numeric_scale AS num_scale, is_nullable, column_default, column_key, extra, column_comment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (table_name REGEXP '^(accounting_actual_report_store_table|accounting_tr_drawdown_table|accounting_traders_report_data_table|actual_previous_settle_vol_accounting_tr_summary_table|asia_working_day_map_table|bbg_productcode_table|bbg_ticker_mapping_table|bi_counterparty_mapping_table|broker_bbg_mapping_table|broker_column_name_mapping_table|broker_deal_mapping_table|broker_trade_deal_master_table|brokerage_rate_type_table|client_cash_balance_contractwise_table|cost_master_table|dripping_counter_party_report_store_table|frequency_type_table|grasa_client_master_data|helper_screen_netting_table|input_security_settlement_value_cache_table|subportfolio_fy_monthwise_opening_balance_table|subportfolio_portfolio_table|helper_dbtodw_otctrade_dump_table|helper_dbtodw_exchtrade_dump_table|activity_log)(_[a-z0-9][a-z0-9][a-z0-9])?$') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT table_name, index_name, non_unique, seq_in_index, column_name, index_type FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (table_name REGEXP '^(accounting_actual_report_store_table|accounting_tr_drawdown_table|accounting_traders_report_data_table|actual_previous_settle_vol_accounting_tr_summary_table|asia_working_day_map_table|bbg_productcode_table|bbg_ticker_mapping_table|bi_counterparty_mapping_table|broker_bbg_mapping_table|broker_column_name_mapping_table|broker_deal_mapping_table|broker_trade_deal_master_table|brokerage_rate_type_table|client_cash_balance_contractwise_table|cost_master_table|dripping_counter_party_report_store_table|frequency_type_table|grasa_client_master_data|helper_screen_netting_table|input_security_settlement_value_cache_table|subportfolio_fy_monthwise_opening_balance_table|subportfolio_portfolio_table|helper_dbtodw_otctrade_dump_table|helper_dbtodw_exchtrade_dump_table|activity_log)(_[a-z0-9][a-z0-9][a-z0-9])?$') ORDER BY table_name, index_name, seq_in_index

SELECT table_name, table_type, table_rows AS est_rows FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (table_name LIKE '%activity%log%' OR table_name LIKE '%working_day%' OR table_name LIKE '%bbg_product%' OR table_name LIKE '%bbg_ticker%' OR table_name LIKE '%bi_counterparty%' OR table_name LIKE '%broker_bbg%' OR table_name LIKE '%broker_column%' OR table_name LIKE '%broker_deal_mapping%' OR table_name LIKE '%broker_trade_deal%' OR table_name LIKE '%brokerage_rate%' OR table_name LIKE '%cash_balance_contract%' OR table_name LIKE '%cost_master%' OR table_name LIKE '%frequency_type%' OR table_name LIKE '%grasa_client_master%' OR table_name LIKE '%screen_netting%' OR table_name LIKE '%security_settlement_value_cache%' OR table_name LIKE '%fy_monthwise%' OR table_name LIKE '%subportfolio_portfolio%' OR table_name LIKE '%dbtodw%' OR table_name LIKE '%actual_previous_settle%' OR table_name LIKE '%tr_drawdown%' OR table_name LIKE '%traders_report_data%' OR table_name LIKE '%dripping_counter_party%' OR table_name LIKE '%actual_report_store%') ORDER BY table_name

at least some of the tables have keys
